serve hello.text
expand src_var.cel src.cel
cmpenv src.cel src_var.cel 

mito -cfg cfg.yaml -use http,try src.cel
cmp stdout want.txt
! stderr .

-- cfg.yaml --
max_body_size: 3
-- hello.text --
hello
-- src_var.cel --
// $URL is set by the serve command and ${URL} is expanded by the expand command.
try(post("${URL}","text/plain",""))
-- want.txt --
"response body too big"
